guide.text: Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. Two-Face's attacks inflict [Bleeding] on enemies affected by [Panic], dealing damage over time. The healing reduction prevents them from restoring HP while bleeding, causing their HP to steadily drain until they're defeated.
Boosts Crit Rate and inflicts healing reduction when Arsenal's Ultimate hits, making it ideal for continuous damage with arrow barrages and turrets, especially against squads that rely on healing.

Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. Aquaman's Ultimate pulls enemies together, and with the healing reduction, it shuts down healing-heavy squads, trapping enemies in [Water Prison] with little chance to recover.

Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. Deadshot excels at reducing enemy healing, and with Tectonic Disruptor's healing reduction, he severely weakens targets that rely on strong sustained healing.

Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. Nurse Harley's enhanced basic attacks inflict [Corrosion] for sustained damage, and the healing reduction ensures affected enemies steadily lose HP over time until they're defeated.

Increases Crit Rate and has a chance to reduce enemy healing. As a physical Firepower Champion, Lobo thrives on high crits and empowered basic attacks. The Tectonic Disruptor ramps up his crit potential and complements his healing reduction effect from basic attacks.
Increases Attack and Physical Penetration, pushing Aquaman's damage even higher while his waterspouts reduce enemy defenses. Ideal for a stronger opening burst.
